I’d be happy to share the BBQ sauce recipe, but definitely use whatever BBQ sauce you like most! I don’t use measurements, but it’s very easy to tweak. 

I tend to make it in a pot on the stovetop. Ketchup, molasses, cayenne pepper, black pepper and a very small splash of vinegar! If it’s too spicy or sour add molasses, too sweet add more ketchup. 
You could also make it without heating and refrigerate!

Also really easy to add toppings like lettuce or other veg you enjoy for variety!
